title: Face Gallery
short_description: Browse photos and videos, organise people and match contact portraits locally.
full_description:
Your photos, videos and familiar faces, together in one gallery.

Face Gallery helps you browse local media and organise photos by the people in them. Face recognition runs on your phone. Photo content, contacts and face signatures are not uploaded to the developer or a cloud recognition service.

BROWSE YOUR LIBRARY
Explore photos and videos, browse albums and save favourites. Resize the photo grid with a pinch. Zoom and rotate photos, or play a local video with playback and seeking controls. Supported video formats depend on your device.

FIND YOUR PEOPLE
Enable on-device face recognition to build people groups. Tap a face to see related photos, add a name and correct a match when needed. Recognition is an organising aid and can make mistakes; it is not identity verification.

OPTIONAL CONTACT MATCHING
Allow contacts access to choose a contact name or match suitable contact portraits to unnamed people groups. Clear matches can name a group automatically. Missing or unclear contact portraits leave grouping unchanged. You can also enter a name without contacts access.

WORK AT YOUR PACE
Automatic recognition saves completed work and can continue after you close the gallery. It pauses when battery is low, the phone is hot or battery saver is active. Android controls background scheduling, so processing may be delayed. Pause background recognition in Settings or start a scan from Recognition tools.

YOU CONTROL ACCESS
Choose whether to enable automatic people recognition. Grant access to photos and videos you want to browse; supported Android versions let you choose selected media. Contacts are optional. Review the privacy policy in the app, manage permissions and clear saved recognition results when you choose.

No ads. No account required. Works with local media on Android 9 and later.
release_notes: Browse local photos and videos, organise people on your phone and optionally match contact portraits. Includes privacy choices and controls for background recognition.
